text:
Everyone rides the ropeway to Lake Ashi in Hakone.
From Gora, a ¥910 bus gets you there too 👇

🤔 Which is quicker from Gora to Togendai?
👉 The bus or the cable car plus ropeway? Check:
https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

🚡 Option A: the ropeway loop
Cable car to Sounzan, then the gondola.
About 30 minutes over Owakudani's steam vents.
💴 ¥2,000 one way, included in the Freepass.

🚌 Option B: the bus
The "S" bus to Kowakien, then the H line.
Two short rides, 20 to 30 minutes.
💴 ¥910 to Moto-Hakone, on the Freepass too.
You get off a short walk from Hakone Shrine's torii.

🔁 Option C: mix them
Ropeway and boat out in the morning.
Then the bus home from Moto-Hakone.

💭 Our take
First visit with a Freepass? Do C.
Windy or misty, or done the ropeway before?
Bus both ways, and spend the saved hour in an onsen.

👉 The refund most Freepass holders forget to ask for:
https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

Which would you pick: the views or the shortcut?
